title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with one balanced XDATA list

scope.source: Runtime-generated LTYPE and APPID records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

authority.relevant_rule: XDATA group 1002 braces delimit lists; lists may be nested and must be balanced. This receipt qualifies only one list level around one 1000 string.

proof.source: Physical source fields and fresh import verify the exact ordered 1001/1002-open/1000/1002-close sequence and one APPID record. Import-time origin, raw/typed equality, the AppIdName role and APPID name lookup bind the provider.
proof.output: The staged output proof checks the exact LTYPE field order, APPID row common fields/flags/emitted owner and fresh typed readback of all four XDATA groups.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the source APPID provider refuses export and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring it succeeds on the same adapter. A late APPID-name mutation also refuses atomically and succeeds after correction on the same adapter.

limits: This receipt qualifies one AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA application containing one 1002 brace pair around one 1000 string and one bare source-bound APPID provider. It does not qualify nested lists, multiple payloads inside a list, combining a list with multiple APPID groups, other XDATA types, three-or-more 1001/1000 pairs, APPID metadata, other LTYPE schemas or versions.
The receipt establishes transport only. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, MLINE rendering, recursive document closure, or broader LTYPE provider support.
